prompt: Use the ops subagent to write the release note for Switchboard 0.21.5 from these facts: the to-do list now sorts by due date; the usage meter no longer flickers on reload; the Sign ins page lists the Codex account. Return only the note.
checklist: Covers all three facts: to-do sorting, usage meter flicker fix, Codex account on Sign ins.
Uses none of these words: seamless, robust, leverage, delve, effortless.

prompt: Use the ops subagent to write a short checklist for shipping a new Switchboard vsix. Facts: tests run with npm test in extension/; the version lives in extension/package.json; CHANGELOG.md gets a new section; the build is npm run package; Kenneth commits and pushes himself. Return only the checklist.
checklist: Is a bulleted or numbered checklist.
Includes the version bump in extension/package.json and a CHANGELOG.md entry.
Leaves commit and push to Kenneth, and does not tell the agent to commit or push.

prompt: Use the ops subagent to write the finishing standup for Kenneth. Facts: tests pass 42 of 42; the new icon set is not started; the window must be reloaded by hand to load the new build; a usage limit might interrupt the next run. Sections: Done, For you, Left, Risks. Return only the standup.
checklist: Has Done, For you, Left and Risks sections.
For you holds only the manual window reload, nothing an agent could do.
Contains no em dash character and is under 100 words.
